policy: Every entry is a planning recommendation with approvalStatus=not-approved. Disruptive entries name affected systems, additive compatibility controls, and a separate gate.

repositories.method: source inventory plus program dependency analysis
repositories.rationale: Owns provisional schema-source decision, semantic IR/compiler, language emitters, compatibility diffing, and published shared packages.
repositories.gate: filament-core-data#7 cross-language/Avro gate and #12 consumer-readiness gate
repositories.recommendation: Finish TypeSpec/JSON Schema decision and semantic IR before compiler code; publish nothing from the census.

repositories.rationale: Twenty-one strict Python DTOs overlap core concepts and event publication lacks a versioned envelope.

compatibilityControls.name: generated models coexist with current Pydantic models

repositories.gate: filament-domain-events#5 pre-merge consumer and compatibility gate
repositories.recommendation: Map existing UUID/tenant models into generated packages and add an envelope only after consumers are known.

repositories.method: committed SQLModel/service inspection with dirty-worktree limitation
repositories.rationale: Sixteen persisted entities, services, JSON/JSONB fields, and generic event publication overlap the shared semantic model; local compatibility work is uncommitted.
repositories.gate: filament-core-service#20 persistence alignment plus database row-count/backup/backfill/rollback evidence
repositories.recommendation: Keep SQLModel and server defaults authoritative until an additive mapping is proven; do not normalize dirty user work.

repositories.method: issue #8 branch and Python adapter inspection
repositories.rationale: The branch correctly delegates Tier 2 to Quire, but live adapter types and frozen legacy models still need consumer/parity evidence.
repositories.recommendation: Merge/resolve the current shim separately; later replace handwritten adapter DTOs additively.

repositories.method: Rust/TS source, migration, project, and worktree analysis
repositories.rationale: The application has the richest extraction, persistence, service, NDJSON, and generated TS contracts plus six active worktrees and an unfinished graph-baseline epic.

compatibilityControls.name: no envelope change during DTO adoption

repositories.gate: filament-ide-rs#567 DTO gate and #566 database migration gate
repositories.recommendation: Freeze shared DTO boundary only after #511 and active core/assurance work stabilize; preserve NDJSON as best-fit transport.

repositories.rationale: Quire already owns the right parser/validator/extractor boundary; work is mainly stable semantic extraction/export mapping, not rendering or cross-language generation.
repositories.gate: quire-rs#388 compatibility fixtures and Project 18 advisory gate
repositories.recommendation: Add semantic extraction metadata only after the module package contract; keep generation outside Quire.

repositories.method: catalog pin, config, issue, and dirty-worktree analysis
repositories.rationale: Quoin owns distribution and exact pins, while active intervention-evidence/spec-fuzz work overlaps evidence/module semantics and the board collection is capped.
repositories.recommendation: Record architecture and manifest semantics first; do not change pins or publish enforcing releases from this audit.

repositories.rationale: The complete-graph truth set is fit and pinned; it is an evidence dependency, not a semantic business schema.
repositories.gate: No migration gate; pin corpus_revision for every comparison
repositories.recommendation: Reuse the corpus as graph-correctness evidence and keep semantic-module type fit in quoin#288.

concepts.rationale: Current Avro/TS/Python/fixture surface is internally consistent, though Python lacks generated classes.
concepts.gate: Avro compatibility gate before any source-of-truth change
concepts.recommendation: Retain as compatibility baseline and generate richer packages beside it.

concepts.rationale: Core nouns span definition, extraction, persistence, wire, and presentation planes with incompatible identity and JSON boundaries.
concepts.gate: semantic IR acceptance plus per-consumer migration gates
concepts.recommendation: Model definition/occurrence and stable identity explicitly; never replace all records with one universal entity.

concepts.rationale: No versioned event envelope or known consumer set exists.
Ownership is correct but adapter field parity and versioning are handwritten.
concepts.recommendation: Generate adapter types only after stable semantic extraction contract.

concepts.rationale: Four representations cover complementary responsibilities but lack one accepted module package/export/mapping contract.
concepts.gate: Project 18 architecture and semantic-module contract review

concepts.method: legacy model and repository policy inspection
concepts.rationale: Frozen legacy objects lack source/provenance completeness but may still have unknown callers.
concepts.recommendation: Do not extend; retire only after callers and parity are proven.

concepts.rationale: Physical migrations are representation-local and any semantic alignment could require backfill or index changes.
concepts.recommendation: No database change during schema/compiler work.

concepts.rationale: NDJSON is a suitable local daemon transport with typed Rust envelopes and known clients.
concepts.recommendation: Keep NDJSON; project shared types into it where useful.

concepts.rationale: The truth set is well versioned and explicit about unsupported computations.
concepts.recommendation: Reuse without redefining it as semantic module authority.

concepts.method: scoped absence search and interface-fit analysis
concepts.rationale: No current interface requires Protobuf and introducing it now adds a second generated contract prematurely.
concepts.recommendation: Choose Protobuf only per interface; do not standardize it universally.

concepts.method: scoped absence search plus QA accumulation needs analysis
concepts.rationale: Arrow/Parquet is useful for accumulated results but its source semantics are not yet stable.
concepts.gate: analytical projection specification and golden round-trip gate
concepts.recommendation: Implement only after run/result/evidence reconciliation; never treat columnar output as source authority.

activeOverlaps.overlap: Shared authority, package, projection, and compatibility architecture
activeOverlaps.sequencingConsequence: Issue #10 PR must depend on or follow #16; no independent conflicting architecture edits.
Do not edit or absorb uncommitted files; refresh service disposition before migration planning.
Resolve shim review before parser adoption ticket starts.
Freeze semantic identity and graph mapping only after a stable #511 boundary.

activeOverlaps.overlap: Retrieval, assurance, core primitive, and UI binding contracts
activeOverlaps.sequencingConsequence: Re-snapshot each branch and owner before DTO migration; do not rebase or modify these worktrees.
Use as semantic input for analytical projections instead of defining a parallel Filament evidence record.
Keep current catalog pin source read-only and refresh after active branch resolution.

activeOverlaps.overlap: Unknown contract work beyond enumerated page
activeOverlaps.sequencingConsequence: Migration-readiness review must use paginated GraphQL or remain incomplete; this audit cannot certify no other overlaps.
